Head of Design

Our design org is 6 designers strong, established over eight years, with its own budget, research practice, and a seat at the planning table. The previous Head of Design was promoted internally; you will inherit a functional, senior team that needs a leader focused on growth and craft, not a turnaround.

Responsibilities:
- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of six designers: regular 1:1s, growth plans, honest feedback, hiring for two open roles, and promotion advocacy.
- Run and evolve the design critique practice; coach designers on craft directly.
- Own the evolution of our design system in partnership with its dedicated team.
- Report to our CPO (a former designer); collaborate as a peer with engineering and product directors who already work design-first.
- Guide the design org's adoption of AI-assisted workflows — define the strategy for how the team uses new tools well.
- Keep your own craft sharp: leaders here review work in the tools, not in slide decks.

You have led design teams at product companies for 5+ years, developed multiple designers into senior and lead roles, and prefer deepening one product over hopping between engagements. We are a calm company: sustainable pace, no heroics, async by default. Remote, US.
